habitat: In small Gypsum area(ca. 2 km by 1 km) resulting from evaporite diapir eruption. An extremely interesting Gypsum endemic flora present, dominated by species of Haploesthes, Nerisyrenia, Tiquilia, Dicranocarpus, Fouquieria, Agave, Xanthisima, etc. A diverse set of cacti present, as well as Acleisanthes, Nama and Drymaria.  Conditions reasonable to good on Gypsum, despite relatively dry condition s elsewhere.
locality: At the base of limestone-capped mesa ca. 3 km NNE of Ejido Carricitos.
